visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with shoulder-length hair wearing a vibrant, multicolored patterned shirt dances energetically in a spacious, white studio with track lighting. (2) He stands with another man and a woman who enters holding a white plastic bag, all three appearing to be in the middle of a social gathering or game. (3) The man in the patterned shirt puts on a red knit beanie and a brown crocheted beard accessory, sitting on the floor while holding a large red sign with a white chair icon. (4) A woman in a navy blue shirt draws a paper from a Santa hat held by a bearded man in a black t-shirt and grey cap. (5) She unwraps a gift to reveal a giant white replica of an earbud which she holds up to her head. (6) Two women, one in a green tracksuit and another in a green sweatshirt, engage in a playful struggle on the floor over a large gift wrapped in red paper. (7) A man in a black t-shirt pulls a white t-shirt with a humorous photo of himself printed on it out of a black bag. (8) The man in the patterned shirt opens a white box to reveal a plastic container containing a very large, live beetle larva on a bed of soil, causing everyone to react with shock. (9) The scene shifts to an office setting where a woman sitting at a desk receives a green gift bag and reveals a white toilet seat. (10) A woman receives a spiral-bound calendar featuring various stylized and humorous photographs of the man in the patterned shirt in different costumes and poses. (11) The group gathered in the office shouts and claps in excitement as the calendar is displayed.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-arousal shouting from a male voice over an energetic, fast-tempo synth BGM. (2) A transition SFX occurs, followed by the male voice narrating the drawing of lottery slips, while female voices chatter in the background. (3) A comedic 'fanfare' music cue plays as a gift is revealed, accompanied by female laughter and high-pitched exclamations. (4) Chaotic crowd noise increases as multiple people shout and wrestle, punctuated by the rustle of plastic and thuds. (5) A 'ding' SFX marks the revelation of the beetle larva, leading to loud, sustained screaming from several female voices and a drop in BGM volume for dramatic effect. (6) The scene shifts with a hard cut to office ambience where casual conversation is heard under a persistent pop BGM. (7) A final loud cheering sequence with rhythmic clapping and shouting concludes the track as the calendar is revealed.
